mother.reading: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target Image 1 is the approved 1536x1024 reading-room master. Image 2 is the exact character identity reference for Takamatsu Tomori (高松灯) from BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. Produce ONE full-canvas 1536x1024 anime scene, same camera, crop, window, pale blank left wall, lake and campus clock tower, window bench, cushions, floor, shelves, plants, and daylight as Image 1. Replace ONLY Sakiko, the long blue-haired girl, with the exact Tomori from Image 2: SHORT muted gray-purple bob, warm gold-brown eyes, soft clearly youthful original anime face, gray school blazer with white piping, white shirt, dark green striped necktie, dark pleated skirt, dark knee socks, brown loafers. No blue long hair, no adult or photorealistic face, no generic character. Match Image 1's seated reading pose, spatial footprint, hip contact on the bench, legs and complete shoes, book held naturally at lap, gentle absorbed reading expression. Tomori is leaning toward the open book while keeping the entire left 55% clear. Preserve the approved room and its warm soft anime linework and light exactly; do not redesign furniture, move the sitter, zoom, crop, add interface, text, logos, or extra people. Whole character physically seated with matched perspective, contact shadow and sunlight, no floating feet or sticker look.

figure.chat: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is the attached 1536x1024 complete Tomori room master. Create ONE genuine transparent RGBA extraction at EXACTLY the same FULL 1536x1024 canvas size. Keep the girl Takamatsu Tomori and all items she is holding (her small notebook and the small stone in her hand), including every hair edge, hands, blazer, skirt, complete knee socks, and both complete shoes. Preserve her exact original image coordinates, size, pose, tilt and perspective. The head, hip contact point, knees and shoe soles must be at their original pixels. REMOVE every room/background pixel, bench, cushions, floor, window, plants, wall, lamp and furniture to alpha=0. No cast floor shadow. Keep ONLY the original character silhouette and held object opaque; allow anti-alias alpha only along edges. This is an extraction, NOT a redraw or character restyling. Absolutely do NOT crop, recenter, zoom, resize the character, shift her, change her anatomy, close gaps between legs, omit shoes, fill the background with white/gray/checkerboard, or add anything. The left roughly 55 percent of the image must remain completely transparent exactly as in the source framing. The alpha channel of this output will be used as a full-canvas mask over the ORIGINAL mother image pixels; exact source alignment is essential. Preserve transparent background in the actual PNG.
